executiveSummary: Inspection of Example Conveyancing Co Ltd identifies six non-compliant findings on a single £875,000 purchase matter. The most serious issues concern borrower identity, source-of-funds evidence for a third-party gift, enhanced due diligence, MLRO procedure, unresolved source-of-funds schedule gaps, and bank-statement coverage. The file also contains clear compliant evidence for proof of address, estate distribution funds, lender disclosure, costs information, and complaints information. One good-practice finding is noted because the source-of-funds schedule clearly records supported, partial, and outstanding evidence streams.
